abstract: Risk pooling has become an increasingly critical tool for managing risks among corporations, institutions, states, and nations, with examples including multinational pooling, decentralized insurance schemes, catastrophe risk pooling, and burden sharing for nuclear accidents. Although there has been a rich literature on such practices, little is known from a theoretical viewpoint regarding the operational strategies of risk pools and, in particular, on issues about the effect of a pool’s expansion on each existing member’s welfare. This paper is the first to explore these issues by establishing different notions of consensus for the expansion of a risk pool: strong consensus, where both existing members and new candidates improve their risk measures due to the pool’s expansion, and weak consensus, which refers to the willingness of existing members to remain in the pool. Under optimal risk sharing for each pool, we show that its properties regarding expansion’s effects depend strongly on the underlying pricing rule. For instance, only with risk-adjusted equilibrium pricing are existing members willing to accept highly risky new members, whereas simple linear pricing excludes such members from the pool. Additionally, the impact of exogenous reinsurance on consensus is analyzed under both pricing rules. The established framework offers valuable managerial insights and policy implications, which we illustrate through two indicative case studies based on real data. This paper was accepted by Agostino Capponi, finance. abstract_zh: 风险池已成为企业管理企业、机构、州和国家之间风险的一种日益关键的工具，其示例包括跨国风险池、分散式保险计划、巨灾风险池以及核事故负担分担。尽管关于此类实践已有丰富的文献，但从理论视角来看，人们对风险池的运营策略知之甚少，尤其是关于风险池扩张对每个现有成员福利影响的问题。本文首次通过建立风险池扩张的不同共识概念来探讨这些问题：强共识，即现有成员和新候选成员均因风险池扩张而改善其风险度量；弱共识，即现有成员愿意留在风险池中。在每个风险池的最优风险分担下，我们表明其关于扩张效应的性质强烈依赖于 underlying pricing rule。例如，只有在风险调整均衡定价下，现有成员才愿意接受高风险的新成员，而简单线性定价则会将此类成员排除在风险池之外。此外，本文还在两种定价规则下分析了外生再保险对共识的影响。所建立的框架提供了有价值的管理见解和政策启示，我们通过两个基于真实数据的指示性案例研究加以说明。本文由 Agostino Capponi 接受，金融领域。资助：感谢清华大学经济管理学院 [研究资助 2023051001]、国家社会科学基金 [重大项目 23&ZD178] 的财务支持，以及清华大学自主科研计划 [2024THZWYY02]。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06863 获取。
